title: Class balance
text:
Targeted changes for the two classes that cleared monsters fastest.

• Barbarian: auto attacks and every ability deal a further 12% less damage. In testing it cleared monsters almost twice as fast as any other class
• Barbarian: Savagery now adds 12% critical damage per rank (was 20%)
• Assassin: Ambush deals 20% less damage and Eviscerate 10% less
• Assassin: Opportunist now adds 10% damage from stealth per rank (was 20%), Lethality 7% critical damage per rank (was 10%), and Death Mark 20% Eviscerate damage (was 35%, still refunds a combo point)
